title: Santa Monica’s Affordable Post-Fair is Going To Paris This Fall
summary: Post-Fair, an alternative art fair held in a Santa Monica post office that was launched by gallerist Chris Sharp in 2025, will expand to Paris this October. The innovative fair’s first international edition will debut during Art Basel Paris and be staged in two buildings in the Marais, a swerve from its highly specific locational origins. title: David Odo to Lead Honolulu Museum of Art
summary: The Honolulu Museum of Art (HoMA) has announced David Odo as its new director. Odo, who specializes in nineteenth-century photography of Japan joins the institution from the Georgia Museum of Art at the University of Georgia in Athens, where he is director and chief curator. title: Valerie Brathwaite, Whose Curvaceous and Colorful Sculptures Channeled the Natural World of the Caribbean, Is Dead
summary: Trinidadian-born Caracas-based abstract sculptor Valerie Brathwaite, who drew on what she described as the “overwhelming beauty” of nature to create vibrantly hued organic forms, has died. She was variously reported to have been between eighty-six and eighty-eight. Her death was announced on July 6 by the Museo de Arte Latinoamericano de Buenos Aires (MALBA) in an Instagram post. […]

title: Marlborough Gallery’s Former Chelsea Space Sells for $7.5 Million to Gazelli Art House
summary: Marlborough‘s former New York home, vacated after the venerable gallery’s 2024 closure, was recently sold for $7.5 million to Gazelli Art House. Founded in 1946 by Frank Lloyd and Harry Fischer, Marlborough operated for nearly 80 years and represented top-name contemporary artists like Lucian Freud and Francis Bacon before the outfit’s eventual demise. title: Busan Biennale Names Artists for 2026 Edition
summary: The organizers of the Busan Biennale have announced the forty-six artists and collectives from twenty-two countries participating in the 2026 edition, set to take place August 29–November 1. title: New Prize from Fundación Kahlo Will Support Emerging Mexican Artists
summary: Fundación Kahlo for Mexican Art and Culture, a New York-based nonprofit established for the preservation of Freida Kahlo’s artistic legacy, has announced its new Kahlo Art Prize.
